title: My Tech Journey
content: My journey into technology began with a curiosity to understand complex systems and how real-world solutions are built. This drive led me to pursue a B.ENG in Chemical Engineering, where I developed strong foundations in systems analysis, process optimization, and data-driven problem solving. While at university, I transitioned into software development, completing a Full-Stack Engineering program at ALX Africa, Coursera, 3MTT program, refining my skills in frontend and backend technologies, modern frameworks, and software architecture. Through internships and independent projects, I gained hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, automation, AI/ML, and UI/UX design. Today, I leverage this multidisciplinary background to architect and build scalable, efficient, and user-centric applications, combining engineering rigor with practical software solutions.
